fares.basic.cancel.afterDeparture.statement: On Basic, a cancellation after the first flight returns nothing.

fares.basic.cancel.beforeDeparture.statement: On Basic, a cancellation before departure returns nothing.

fares.basic.cancel.noShow.statement: On Basic, a cancellation after a missed flight returns nothing.

fares.basic.change.afterDeparture.statement: On Basic, a change of flight after the first flight is refused.

fares.basic.change.beforeDeparture.statement: On Basic, a change of flight before departure is refused.

fares.basic.change.noShow.statement: On Basic, a change of flight after a missed flight is refused.

fares.flex.cancel.afterDeparture.statement: On Flex, a cancellation after the first flight returns the item's whole price to the original form of payment.

fares.flex.cancel.beforeDeparture.statement: On Flex, a cancellation before departure returns the item's whole price to the original form of payment.

fares.flex.cancel.noShow.statement: On Flex, a cancellation after a missed flight returns 100 dollars to the original form of payment, whatever the item's price.

fares.flex.change.afterDeparture.statement: On Flex, a change of flight after the first flight is allowed with no fee, priced from the request's old and new prices.

fares.flex.change.beforeDeparture.statement: On Flex, a change of flight before departure is allowed with no fee, priced from the request's old and new prices.

fares.flex.change.noShow.statement: On Flex, a change of flight after a missed flight is allowed with no fee, priced from the request's old and new prices.

fares.main.cancel.afterDeparture.statement: On Main, a cancellation after the first flight returns 150 dollars to the original form of payment, whatever the item's price.

fares.main.cancel.beforeDeparture.statement: On Main, a cancellation before departure returns 150 dollars to the original form of payment, whatever the item's price.

fares.main.cancel.noShow.statement: On Main, a cancellation after a missed flight returns nothing.

fares.main.change.afterDeparture.statement: On Main, a change of flight after the first flight is allowed with a 75 dollar fee as its penalty, priced from the request's old and new prices.

fares.main.change.beforeDeparture.statement: On Main, a change of flight before departure is allowed with a 75 dollar fee as its penalty, priced from the request's old and new prices.

fares.main.change.noShow.statement: On Main, a change of flight after a missed flight is refused.

amountDue.statement: When the new flight costs at least the price paid and the price paid covers the fee, an allowed change leaves the traveler to pay the fee plus the fare difference, and the airline owes nothing back. This holds under both readings of a fee larger than the refundable value and whether the fee is netted or charged separately. Without the second condition the readings differ: under one, the airline waives the part of the fee above the price paid.

fareDifference.statement: The fare difference of an allowed change is the new flight's price minus the price paid.

farePricePositive.statement: Every Verified Airline fare has a positive price: the price of one booked item on the fare in the worked examples.

moneyNonNegative.statement: An amount of money is never negative: the model counts it in minor units, as a natural number.

refundOverPayment.statement: A refund larger than the payment it is asked against is refused.

refundWithinPayment.statement: A refund no larger than the payment it names is accepted. The rule looks at this one refund and this one payment; whether refunds against one payment are capped in total is the model's open criterion OO-003.2.
